title: BPW-2026-0570
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0570
BOE + BCA
CD 9
SOLE SOURCE CONTRACT – ANDY NESS – LOS ANGELES CONVENTION CENTER EXPANSION AND MODERNIZATION PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to negotiate a sole source contract with Andy Ness for Project Neutral Alternate No. 1 Services for the Los Angeles Convention Center Expansion and Modernization Project for $600,000, with a budget authority not-to-exceed the amount of $300,000 to be funded by the City of Los Angeles and equally matched by Plenary Americas Conventions Los Angeles, LLC formerly known as AEG Plenary Conventions Los Angeles, LLC at an amount not-to-exceed $300,000.
